title: Bone marrow immune remodeling in depression: TNF/NF-kappaB mediated leukocyte redistribution and construction of an interpretable predictive model.
authors: Zhu, Weihao; Shi, Rui; Li, Xiang; Cong, Jingze; An, Yuchuan; He, Mengting; Zhang, Guowei; Wang, Yang; Li, Shujin; Shi, Weibo; Cong, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦抑郁症中骨髓免疫重塑与TNF/NF-kappaB通路，涉及免疫细胞转录组和机器学习预测模型，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Environmental stress contributes to the development of depression through neuro-immune interactions, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms and associated clinical diagnostic biomarkers remain unclear. We established a psychosocial stress mouse model and systematically investigated the immune dysregulation induced by stress through integrated analysis of blood cell profiles, leukocyte transcriptomics, protein-protein interaction networks, single-cell RNA sequencing, and targeted pharmacological intervention. Additionally, we constructed and validated a depression predictive model using multiparametric peripheral blood data and machine learning, and assessed feature importance using the SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis. The results show that stressed mice exhibited increased neutrophils and decreased lymphocytes, which were positively correlated with depressive-like behaviors. Differential expression analysis identified 127 differentially genes enriched in pathways related to immune response, inflammation regulation, and hematopoietic dysfunction. Hub-genes (Rel, Cd274, Icam1, Tnf, Maff, Nfkbia) were upregulated and drove leukocyte redistribution via inflammatory cascades and adhesion mechanisms, whereas TNF/NF-kappaB pathway inhibition (Etanercept/Infliximab) reversed bone marrow immune imbalance and ameliorated depressive-like behavior. The random forest (RF) model trained with RF-mean features and random oversampling resampling based on blood cell parameters achieved 91.60 % accuracy and an AUC of 0.65. SHAP analysis identified RDW, MOPCT, PLTSI, SII, and NPR as biomarkers. In short, this study elucidates the regulatory role of bone marrow immune remodeling in stress-induced depression and proposes a feasible predictive strategy based on multiparametric peripheral blood profiling.
abstract_zh: 环境应激通过神经-免疫相互作用促进抑郁症的发展，但其潜在的分子机制及相关临床诊断生物标志物仍不清楚。我们建立了一个心理社会应激小鼠模型，并通过血细胞谱、白细胞转录组学、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络、单细胞RNA测序和靶向药理学干预的综合分析，系统研究了应激诱导的免疫失调。此外，我们利用多参数外周血数据和机器学习构建并验证了一个抑郁症预测模型，并使用SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 分析评估了特征重要性。结果表明，应激小鼠表现出中性粒细胞增加和淋巴细胞减少，这与抑郁样行为呈正相关。差异表达分析识别出127个差异基因，富集于免疫反应、炎症调节和造血功能障碍相关通路。Hub基因（Rel、Cd274、Icam1、Tnf、Maff、Nfkbia）上调，并通过炎症级联和粘附机制驱动白细胞重新分布，而TNF/NF-kappaB通路抑制（依那西普/英夫利昔单抗）逆转了骨髓免疫失衡并改善了抑郁样行为。基于血细胞参数、使用RF-mean特征和随机过采样重采样训练的随机森林（RF）模型达到了91.60%的准确率和0.65的AUC。SHAP分析确定了RDW、MOPCT、PLTSI、SII和NPR作为生物标志物。总之，本研究阐明了骨髓免疫重塑在应激诱导抑郁症中的调控作用，并提出了一种基于多参数外周血谱的可行预测策略。
